Probes dataset used in examples

probes_final_columns.Rd

Structure and column metadata for the Excel file distributed under inst/extdata/Probes_final_Oligopool11_with_sets.xlsx. The file contains 34 columns describing HT-smFISH probe design results.

Usage

probes_final_columns()

Value

Invisibly returns a character vector of the column names.

Details

Columns include identifiers (ENST, ENSG.x, GeneName.x), probe metrics (dGOpt, ProbeSize, Seq, etc.), quality filters, and barcode fields (BC1*, BC2*, WithComplementSeq). Users should load the Excel file with readxl::read_excel() when they need the actual data content.

Examples

probes_final_columns()
#>  [1] "ENST"              "ENSG.x"            "GeneName.x"       
#>  [4] "SET"               "ENSG.y"            "GeneName.y"       
#>  [7] "dGOpt"             "theStartPos"       "theEndPos"        
#> [10] "ProbeSize"         "Seq"               "dGScore"          
#> [13] "dG37"              "GCpc"              "GCFilter"         
#> [16] "aCompFilter"       "aStackFilter"      "cCompFilter"      
#> [19] "cStackFilter"      "cSpecStackFilter"  "NbOfPNAS"         
#> [22] "PNASFilter"        "RSESeqFilter"      "InsideUTR"        
#> [25] "BC1ID"             "BC1PN"             "BC1WP"            
#> [28] "BC1"               "BC2ID"             "BC2PN"            
#> [31] "BC2WP"             "BC2"               "BC1YHybXBC2"      
#> [34] "WithComplementSeq"
